name: Flowerfoot Swordmaster
description: Offspring {2}. Valiant -- Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, Mice you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
assumptions: Read node C (cost:{2} cond:token;paid_at_cast) as Offspring's own additional-cast-time cost.
couldNotDerive: That the triggering spell/ability must be one YOU control (ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl) -- not captured; the trigger reads as "becomes the target of a spell or ability" with no source-controller restriction.
notes: Fixed Valiant$True ("...for the first time each turn") -- reused the existing cond:once_per_turn flag (same real restriction ActivationLimit$1 already covers under a different Forge field name), verified in the regenerated packet. One narrower gap remains open: ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl restricts WHO controls the triggering spell/ability, a different dimension than the trigger node's own owner (whose occurrence this is) -- the schema's trigger vocabulary has no second owner slot for "who controls the source causing this," so this restriction has nowhere to go without extending that vocabulary. Left open rather than guessed at.
